propositions: E3 deterministic half (stratified sample, frozen baseline, FP-control pool, replay driver seams, pure metrics library, golden tests) is designed and built as WIP on branch calib/6982-e3 but intentionally NOT landed on main because the live gate replay batch was rejected.

The ~450-run LLM batch replay (coarse ~200-ticket sweep plus precise ~50-ticket × 3 candidate and × 3 current runs) is permanently rejected on cost grounds and superseded by d8a5's standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder which accumulates verdict-perturbation signal at $0 marginal cost from production reviews.
History-based baseline mining is infeasible: only ~4 plan-v3 sidecar baselines exist against ~200 needed because the impact_model_version bump stranded the historical baseline.

The replay design removes recall contamination via REVIEW_RESULT.json stripping and controls baseline drift via material-fingerprint guards to measure R1 candidate's true effect on false positives and PASS→BLOCK flips.
The deterministic WIP artifacts (sample, baseline, metrics library, golden tests) are reproducible and offline-verifiable but the live LLM batch was never executed.
